#!/usr/bin/env bash
# freeze.sh - Simulates freezing writes during migration cutover.
# Creates frozen.flag and prints 'Writes frozen'.

set -euo pipefail

SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
FLAG_FILE="$SCRIPT_DIR/frozen.flag"

touch "$FLAG_FILE"
echo "Writes frozen"
